ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by reproduction, not a guess): tests/test_githooks.py passes an ABSOLUTE Windows path to bash - subprocess.run(['bash', str(HOOK_PATH), ...]). Git Bash mangles it (D:\Users\...\.githooks\pre-push becomes DUsers.githookspre-push), cannot find the file, and returns 127. 127 != 0, so the assertion passes no matter what the hook contains. Replacing the hook with a bare 'exit 0' does not change the result. Fix: invoke via a RELATIVE path with cwd=REPO_ROOT (bash .githooks/pre-push), and assert the hook actually ran - returncode not in (0, 127) - or assert on its refusal message on stderr.

CARD DEFECT, found by the supervisor before it bit you - not a failure on your part. TC-010's inputs name python_surface.py as a required module but point you only at _vendor/aspose_extraction/, and it is NOT there. There are TWO distinct Python readers in repository-presenter and they are not interchangeable: (1) .../extractors/surface/_vendor/aspose_extraction/lang/python.py is the tree-sitter-family language adapter - port it as lang/python.py, it is the PARITY ORACLE only; (2) .../extractors/platforms/python_surface.py is the PRODUCTION reader - pure stdlib ast, zero tree-sitter, parses every module without importing or executing anything, records star-imports and unresolvable relative imports as unresolved rather than guessing. Port THAT one as python_surface.py. Your test asserting Python extraction does not use tree-sitter must exercise python_surface.py. Also: the vendored dir additionally contains package_registries/ and publication_probe.py - those are publication-status probes, NOT api-surface extraction. They are OUT of scope for this card; do not port them.

ROOT CAUSE, reproduced against live data, not a guess: classify_richness measures FORMATTING, not INFORMATION. It sees headings, bullets and a fenced code block and returns 'detailed'. Verified against real release bodies your fixtures never contained:
  cells-python  -> detailed  CORRECT
  pdf-go        -> detailed  CORRECT
  font-python   -> detailed  WRONG, must be 'templated'
  empty body    -> none      CORRECT

THE EVIDENCE THAT SETTLES IT: aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python publishes release bodies that are byte-identical in LENGTH (458 chars) across at least six consecutive versions - 26.9.2, 26.9.1, 26.8.4, 26.8.3, 26.8.2, 26.8.1 - differing only in the version number. It is a filled-in template. It is beautifully formatted and it tells a reader nothing about its own release.

WHY THIS WAS INVISIBLE TO YOU: your fixtures and your classifier came from the same idea of what 'detailed' means, so they agreed. No card can catch that from inside itself.

FIX: classify on information content, not markup. Signals that actually discriminate - a template repeats near-identically across versions with only the version string differing; a real note names specific changes, symbols, versions, breakages or fixes. Boilerplate phrases like 'publishes the clean public source package' and generic 'Included' inventories are not per-release information. Do NOT special-case the font-python string or any repo name - that would pass the holdout while still being wrong, and I will re-run it against other data.

Also add a case to your OWN suite covering a filled-in template, so this is caught by the card in future and not only by the holdout.

Real instruction for TC-014: this card carries an open question it is uniquely placed to answer. OQ-001 (see ops/open_questions.jsonl) records that the furnished products.aspose.org page for pdf/net asserts the library 'exposes 805 classes', while our own extraction found 899 TYPES and the reduced fixture's kind split extrapolates to roughly 644 CLASSES. So when you build citation.py, make sure a numeric claim in furnished prose is a first-class case: a sentence asserting a countable fact that the raw-knowledge tier cannot corroborate must be excluded or explicitly qualified, never silently retained. Add a test using that real 805-classes sentence. You do not have to resolve the number itself - the fixture is deliberately reduced and cannot settle it - you have to make the system REFUSE to serve it as a citable fact. Say so in your report and I will close OQ-001 against your test.
